reconfigure.title: Update Tapo robot vacuum connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or the Tapo account used for this vacuum. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tapo robot vacuum
reauth_confirm.description: The vacuum at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the email and password of the Tapo account it was set up with.

discovery_confirm.title: Tapo robot vacuum found
discovery_confirm.description: A Tapo robot vacuum answered at {host}. Enter your Tapo account to add it.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect: check the IP address and that the vacuum is on
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials: check your Tapo email and password
error.not_vacuum: The device at this address is a Tapo device, but not a robot vacuum: check the IP address

abort.already_in_progress: This vacuum is already being set up
abort.not_tapo_vacuum: The device at this address does not answer on the robot's port

clean_rooms.name: Clean specific rooms
clean_rooms.description: Send the vacuum to clean one or more named rooms. Optional suction / water / passes apply to this run (they set the robot's current clean settings first).

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: List of room names to clean (partial match, case-insensitive).

map.name: Map
map.description: Optional map name to search in (e.g. "Downstairs"). Defaults to current map.

room_ids.name: Room ids
room_ids.description: Room numbers on the map instead of names (as the card sends them); works for unnamed rooms and rooms that share a name.

map_id.name: Map id
map_id.description: The map the room_ids were picked on (sent by the card). The clean is refused if the vacuum is now on another map.

set_room_settings.name: Set room settings
set_room_settings.description: Per-room suction / water / passes stored on the robot (the app's custom cleaning settings). RV30 Max Plus firmware 1.3.3 rejects this; there, use clean_rooms with suction / water / passes, or a preset.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names to store the settings for (as in the Tapo app).

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction to store for these rooms.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level to store for these rooms.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes to store for these rooms, 1 to 3.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map the rooms are on (name). Defaults to the current map.

clean_zone.name: Clean zones
clean_zone.description: Clean rectangles given as [x1, y1, x2, y2] in the map's real coordinates (mm, same frame as the vacuum's position_mm attribute). Starts the robot.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Rectangles to clean as [x1, y1, x2, y2] in map mm (the frame of position_mm), for example [[-500, -500, 500, 500]].

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction for this run (optional; defaults to the current setting).

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for this run (optional; defaults to the current setting).

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes for this run, 1 to 3 (optional; defaults to 1).

run_schedule.name: Run a saved schedule now
run_schedule.description: Start the clean a Tapo-app schedule would start, right now. The vacuum has no "run schedule" call, so this replays the schedule's rooms / preset, suction, water and passes. Get the id from the Schedules sensor's attributes.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: The schedule's id (S1, S2, ...), as listed in the Schedules sensor's attributes.

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Send any device method (with params) and get the response back. While the robot is working only the methods the integration itself uses are allowed, unless Force is on.

method.name: Method
method.description: Robot API method name, for example getVacStatus. Methods that could brick or reset the robot are refused.

params.name: Params
params.description: Parameters for the method as an object (optional).

force.name: Force
force.description: Send even while the robot is cleaning, returning or paused. Off by default: probing a working robot with unknown or setup-related methods has wiped a map set and clean history on an RV30.

get_clean_records.name: Get cleaning history
get_clean_records.description: Return the vacuum's cleaning history (newest first) plus lifetime totals. Use with "Return response" in Developer Tools or response_variable in scripts.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Only return this many most recent runs.

run_preset.name: Run a preset
run_preset.description: Start a cleaning preset saved in the Tapo app (the robot's own "customisation rules"), exactly as the app would. Switches map first if the preset is on another map.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset name (partial, accent-insensitive) or id. See the preset buttons.

set_map.name: Switch map
set_map.description: Make another saved map the active one (multi-floor homes). The robot relocalises.

rename_map.name: Rename map
rename_map.description: Admin only. Rename a saved map on the robot, as the Tapo app does. The robot must be idle. Schedules, presets, room freshness, the planner, area mappings and saved setups follow the map by id and are unaffected; automations that pass the old name as 'map' need the new one (passing the map id avoids that).

map.name: Map
map.description: The map to rename: its id or its full current name (not part of it).

name.name: New name
name.description: 1 to 32 characters. It may not equal, contain or be part of another map's name.

set_map_rotation.name: Set map rotation
set_map_rotation.description: Turn a map's display clockwise by 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Stored on the robot as the Tapo app stores it, so the app shows the map the same way. Display only: rooms, zones, furniture and cleaning are unaffected.

map.name: Map
map.description: Its id or full name. Defaults to the current map.

go_to.name: Go to point
go_to.description: Drive the robot to a point given in the map's real coordinates (mm, same frame as the vacuum's position_mm attribute and tapo_rv30.clean_zone). Stop it with vacuum.stop; vacuum.return_to_base sends it home.

remote_drive.name: Remote drive
remote_drive.description: The Tapo app's remote control. 'enter' takes control (the robot leaves the dock; the response carries how many ms that takes), a direction nudges it one step, 'stop' halts it, 'exit' hands control back. Hold-to-drive is on the Tapo Vacuum sidebar page, which repeats the direction like the app does.

command.name: Command
command.description: enter, forward, backward, left, right, stop or exit.

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Create a cleaning schedule on the robot (same as the Tapo app's Schedules). Returns the new schedule id when called with a response.

time.name: Time
time.description: Start time, in the robot's own time zone.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to repeat on: a list of Mon..Sun, or daily, weekdays or weekend.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names to clean (partial match). Leave rooms and preset empty for the whole house.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset saved in the Tapo app, by name or id, instead of rooms.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map the rooms are on. Defaults to the current map.

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction level for the scheduled run.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for the scheduled run.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes for the scheduled run, 1 to 3.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Create the schedule switched on (default) or off.

ignore_dnd.name: Ignore Do Not Disturb
ignore_dnd.description: Save the schedule even if its start time is inside the robot's Do Not Disturb window. The robot will not run it until the time or the window changes; by default the call is refused instead.

room_ids.name: Room ids
room_ids.description: Room numbers on the current map instead of names (as the sidebar page sends them); works for unnamed rooms and rooms that share a name. An empty list cleans the whole house.

set_schedule.name: Change schedule
set_schedule.description: Change a schedule on the robot. Only the fields you give change; use the schedules sensor for the ids.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The robot's id for the schedule, e.g. S1.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch the schedule on or off.

time.name: Time
time.description: New start time, in the robot's own time zone.

days.name: Days
days.description: New days: a list of Mon..Sun, or daily, weekdays or weekend.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names to clean (partial match). Leave rooms and preset empty for the whole house.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset saved in the Tapo app, by name or id, instead of rooms.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map the rooms are on. Defaults to the current map.

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction level for the scheduled run.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for the scheduled run.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes for the scheduled run, 1 to 3.

ignore_dnd.name: Ignore Do Not Disturb
ignore_dnd.description: Save the change even if the start time is inside the robot's Do Not Disturb window, where the robot will not run it. By default the call is refused instead.

room_ids.name: Room ids
room_ids.description: Room numbers on the current map instead of names (as the sidebar page sends them); works for unnamed rooms and rooms that share a name. An empty list cleans the whole house.

remove_schedule.name: Remove schedule
remove_schedule.description: Delete one schedule from the robot, or all of them.

schedule_id.name: Schedule id
schedule_id.description: The robot's id for the schedule, e.g. S1.

all.name: All
all.description: Remove every schedule instead of one.

remove_matter_fabric.name: Remove Matter fabric
remove_matter_fabric.description: Unpair the robot from one Matter ecosystem. The fabric index and label are attributes of the Matter sensor. Untested on hardware (the author's robot is not paired to anything); it sends the app's removeBindFabric call.

fabric_index.name: Fabric index
fabric_index.description: fabric_index of the ecosystem to remove, from the Matter sensor.

get_matter_setup_code.name: Get Matter setup code
get_matter_setup_code.description: Admin only. Returns the robot's Matter manual pairing code and QR payload, for adding it to another ecosystem while the pairing window is open. The code is never put in entity state.

fetch_cloud_map_backups.name: Fetch cloud map backups
fetch_cloud_map_backups.description: Read-only. Logs in to your TP-Link account, downloads the map backups made with the Tapo app's backup feature, and saves them in config/tapo_rv30/map_backups (with the robot's current local map data for comparison when it is idle). Nothing is sent to the robot except routine reads.

verification_code.name: Verification code
verification_code.description: Only when the first run says TP-Link emailed you a code: enter it here and run again.

save_map_setup.name: Save map setup
save_map_setup.description: Snapshot a map's editable layers (rooms, no-go zones, virtual walls, carpets) to config/tapo_rv30/map_setups. Not the map shape itself. Defaults to the active map.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map name or id. Defaults to the active map.

force.name: Force
force.description: Replace the saved setup even if this map looks degraded (rooms missing or unnamed, as after a lost map).

apply_map_setup.name: Apply map setup
apply_map_setup.description: Put a map back the way its saved setup has it, with the robot's own editing API (no cloud): room names, no-go zones, virtual walls, carpets, furniture, and any presets and schedules that are missing. Setups are saved automatically as the map changes. Robot must be docked and idle.

map.name: Map
map.description: Map name or id. Defaults to the active map.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Required unless dry_run: this writes to the map, presets and schedules.

source_map.name: Source setup
source_map.description: Apply a setup saved under a different map (for a remapped floor, which gets a new id). Name or id of the saved snapshot. Defaults to this map's own.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report what would be written; change nothing.

create_preset.name: Create a preset
create_preset.description: Save a new cleaning preset on the robot, the same as making one in the Tapo app. It then shows up as a preset button and in run_preset, schedules and the app.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms to clean, in cleaning order (partial names are fine).

map.name: Map
map.description: Map the rooms are on. Defaults to the current map.

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction for every room in the preset. Defaults to the robot's current setting.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for every room in the preset. Defaults to the robot's current setting.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes for every room, 1 to 3. Defaults to the robot's current setting.

clean_order.name: Clean in this order
clean_order.description: Clean the rooms in the order given (default on).

update_preset.name: Edit a preset
update_preset.description: Change an existing preset: rename it, change its rooms, or change the suction, water or passes for all its rooms. Anything left out stays as it is.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset to edit, by name or id.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Replace its rooms with these, in cleaning order (optional).

suction.name: Suction
suction.description: Suction for every room in the preset.

water.name: Water
water.description: Water level for every room in the preset.

clean_order.name: Clean in this order
clean_order.description: Clean the rooms in the listed order.

delete_preset.name: Delete a preset
delete_preset.description: Delete a preset from the robot. Schedules that use it stop working, so check them first.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset to delete, by name or id.

restore_map_backup.name: Restore map backup
restore_map_backup.description: Put a whole map backup back on the robot, over its map, or as a new map with new_name. Home Assistant serves the backup on your network and the robot fetches it; the robot must be docked and idle. Works even if the map was deleted: the current map carries the restore, and its room names and furniture are put back afterwards.

map.name: Map
map.description: The map to restore: its name or id. It can be a map that is no longer on the robot (from its saved setup).

file.name: File
file.description: A backup file in config/tapo_rv30/map_backups to use instead of the newest one for this map.

base_url.name: Base URL
base_url.description: Home Assistant's direct LAN address (for example http://192.168.1.10:8123) if the robot cannot reach it through the detected one, such as behind a reverse proxy.

use_cloud_url.name: Use cloud URL
use_cloud_url.description: Let the robot download the backup from TP-Link's cloud instead of from Home Assistant.

verification_code.name: Verification code
verification_code.description: The code TP-Link emailed you, when the cloud download asks for one.

new_name.name: New map name
new_name.description: Restore the backup as a new map with this name, next to the map it came from (a copy), instead of over it. The robot holds at most 3 maps.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on: this replaces the map on the robot (or, with a new name, adds one).

copy_map.name: Copy map
copy_map.description: Copy a map to a new map with its own name: rooms, room names, no-go zones and furniture. The original is left as it is. Uses a fresh TP-Link cloud backup of the map, so it needs the account's cloud login; the robot must be docked and idle.

map.name: Map
map.description: The map to copy: its name or id. Defaults to the current map.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new map's name. The robot holds at most 3 maps.

base_url.name: Base URL
base_url.description: Home Assistant's direct LAN address (for example http://192.168.1.10:8123) if the robot cannot reach it through the detected one, such as behind a reverse proxy.

verification_code.name: Verification code
verification_code.description: The code TP-Link emailed you, when the cloud login asks for one.

local_api_unreachable.title: {name} has stopped answering locally
local_api_unreachable.description: Home Assistant could reach {name} at {host} before, but every poll has failed for the last 10 minutes. If nothing changed on your network, this is most likely the known Tapo firmware regression that breaks local access until the robot is power-cycled. Reboot the vacuum (hold the power button), and consider turning off automatic firmware updates in the Tapo app. This issue clears itself when polling works again.

trigger_type.prompt: Gave a notice (dust bag full, area unreachable, ...)

data.show_panel: Show the Tapo Vacuum page in the sidebar

data_description.show_panel: The sidebar page has the full map, a schedules editor, history and statistics, maintenance and settings. Turn it off if you only want the card and entities.
